projects.title: DECARB-R+J
projects.tagline: Advancing deep decarbonization pathways through endogenous modeling of resilience, justice, and renewable integration.
projects.tagline_es: Avanzando en trayectorias de descarbonización profunda mediante el modelamiento endógeno de la resiliencia, la justicia y la integración de energías renovables.
projects.funding_institution: ANID, Agencia Nacional de Investigación y Desarrollo (Chile)
projects.abstract: DECARB-R+J advances integrated decarbonization modeling by endogenously representing resilience to extreme events, distributional justice, and the pace of renewable deployment. The framework is used to study net-zero and net-negative pathways for Chile under uncertainty, with attention to the social and territorial trade-offs of the transition.
projects.abstract_es: DECARB-R+J avanza en el modelamiento integrado de la descarbonización al representar de forma endógena la resiliencia ante eventos extremos, la justicia distributiva y el ritmo de despliegue de las energías renovables. El marco se utiliza para estudiar trayectorias de carbono neutralidad y de emisiones netas negativas para Chile bajo incertidumbre, considerando las tensiones sociales y territoriales de la transición.
objectives: Extend integrated-assessment modeling with endogenous resilience metrics for extreme climate events.
Embed distributional-justice indicators into long-term capacity-expansion decisions.
Quantify feasible pacing of renewable deployment under investment and supply-chain constraints.
Apply the framework to Chilean net-zero and net-negative pathways and compare policy packages.
projects.methodology: Bilevel and stochastic optimization coupled with an Integrated Assessment Model. Resilience constraints are embedded endogenously through scenario-conditioned reliability metrics; justice is quantified through region- and household-level distributional indicators.

projects.title: APEC Hydrogen Certification
projects.tagline: Building resilient energy policies in Asia-Pacific through certification of hydrogen and its derivatives.
projects.tagline_es: Construyendo políticas energéticas resilientes en Asia-Pacífico mediante la certificación del hidrógeno y sus derivados.
projects.funding_institution: Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation, Energy Working Group
projects.abstract: Policy research project analyzing how APEC economies certify hydrogen and its derivatives, and what the emerging certification landscape means for cross-border trade and market development. Supports the Ministry of Energy of Chile in its APEC engagement on low-carbon hydrogen.
projects.abstract_es: Proyecto de investigación en políticas que analiza cómo las economías APEC certifican el hidrógeno y sus derivados, y qué implica el panorama emergente de certificación para el comercio transfronterizo y el desarrollo de mercados. Apoya al Ministerio de Energía de Chile en su participación en APEC sobre hidrógeno de bajas emisiones.
objectives: Map hydrogen-certification regimes in APEC economies and identify divergences.
Assess implications for cross-border hydrogen trade and market integration.
Produce a policy briefing for the Ministry of Energy of Chile's APEC engagement.
projects.methodology: Comparative policy analysis of APEC economies; structured stakeholder consultations; framework for cross-recognition of certificates.
projects.results: Briefing material delivered to the Ministry of Energy of Chile (2025); public-facing policy report in preparation.

projects.title: INTERNEXUS
projects.tagline: Energy–Water–Food nexus and Power-to-X for deep-decarbonization pathways toward 100% renewable energy systems.
projects.tagline_es: Nexo agua-energía-alimentos y Power-to-X para trayectorias de descarbonización profunda hacia sistemas energéticos 100 % renovables.
projects.funding_institution: ANID, Agencia Nacional de Investigación y Desarrollo (Chile)
projects.abstract: INTERNEXUS develops coupled energy-water-food modeling frameworks to study deep-decarbonization pathways that explicitly account for nexus feedbacks. The project assesses the role of Power-to-X technologies as integrators across sectors and quantifies pathways toward 100% renewable energy systems.
projects.abstract_es: INTERNEXUS desarrolla marcos de modelamiento acoplado de energía, agua y alimentos para estudiar trayectorias de descarbonización profunda que consideran explícitamente las retroalimentaciones del nexo. El proyecto evalúa el rol de las tecnologías Power-to-X como integradoras entre sectores y cuantifica trayectorias hacia sistemas energéticos 100 % renovables.
objectives: Develop a coupled energy-water-food optimization framework.
Assess the role of Power-to-X as a cross-sector integrator.
Quantify 100%-renewable pathways with endogenous nexus constraints.
projects.methodology: Integrated Assessment Modeling (GCAM-LA) soft-linked to a high-resolution power-system optimization model (PyPSA / H2RES).
projects.results: Several Q1 publications in Energy and Energy Strategy Reviews; cross-model linking framework published with applications to Bolivia and Chile.

projects.title: EV & Distributed PV Strategy
projects.tagline: Coordinated deployment of electric vehicles and distributed PV in Chilean households.
projects.tagline_es: Despliegue coordinado de vehículos eléctricos y generación fotovoltaica distribuida en hogares chilenos.
projects.abstract: Studies the coupled deployment of residential PV and electric mobility, with attention to grid-side flexibility, distributional effects, and adoption incentives.
projects.abstract_es: Estudia el despliegue conjunto de la generación fotovoltaica residencial y la electromovilidad, con atención a la flexibilidad de la red, los efectos distributivos y los incentivos a la adopción.
objectives: Characterize household-level adoption patterns for EV+PV.
Design coordinated incentive schemes.
Assess grid-side impacts under high-penetration scenarios.

projects.title: RES-JUST
projects.tagline: Resilient energy systems for a just transition through multiscale modeling.
projects.tagline_es: Sistemas energéticos resilientes para una transición justa mediante modelamiento multiescala.
projects.abstract: Multi-scale modeling framework for resilient energy systems, integrating local, regional, and national perspectives on a just transition. Joint workshop with international partners.
projects.abstract_es: Marco de modelamiento multiescala para sistemas energéticos resilientes, que integra perspectivas locales, regionales y nacionales sobre una transición justa. Incluye un taller conjunto con socios internacionales.
objectives: Develop multi-scale energy-system models with embedded resilience and equity metrics.
Run a 4th International Workshop on Resilient Energy Systems.
Train graduate students through hands-on modeling and policy analysis.

objectives: Build models linking urban form, mobility, and heat exposure.
